notes.title: The Skits-A-Palooza Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Puppeteers!

We’re back!  That’s right, we’ve been quietly working away here and there on the game. Currently working to bring it to new platforms, but more importantly adding in new content for you! So let us tell you what we’ve got!

Today we have pushed out yet another free content update we are dubbing “The Skits-A-Palooza” Update.  We called it that because we’ve added Korean as a language option. Well that’s not true, I mean adding Korean is, but us naming the update because of that isn’t. We called it that because we’ve added a bunch of skits (aka mini games), but before we talk about that we want to tell you about a new character entering the fight. 

Some call him Bigfoot, Yeti, Sasquatch, Missing Link... others call him Missing From the Last Update Where He Should Have Been. We think that’s a long name, so we just call him Biggy Ray Cyprus. So head to the woods, grab a stick and get to fencing with our newest addition. 

The main attraction of course are the new mini games we’ve added to Skits! We’ve got 6 new ways to pick fights with your friends

Destroy - destroy as many asteroids as you can. Warning. The rocket is a little crazy.

Escape - the early bird gets the worm they say. Too bad you are the worm. Escape the talons and survive as long as possible

Joust - an epic showdown of knight versus knight, you only get one hit so make it count

Run - make your way over the hill as fast as you can with your very noodly legs

Hammer - our ode to Bennett Foddy, the OG of wobbly frustration, use the hammer to maneuver yourself to strike your opponent, or the target

Slap - it’s like a regular fight, but you’ve got big slappin’ hands. 

Also can’t forget to mention the new scoring option in Improv mode, Roulette. Each round starts with a random point value, and the winner gets that many points. Just try not to win during a negative points round, yea?

We are also putting Shadow Fencer Theatre on sale with the IndieMegabooth Going Away (For Now) sale, so join the fun for 75% off!

See you on the Stage!
ShuddaHaddaLottaFun Team
